title: steel
description: This mod adds steel items and hardened iron.
body:
The mod adds Hardened Iron, Steel, and Industrial Steel.

Hardened Iron is crafted using an Iron Hammer and 4 iron ingots.

Hardened Iron can be smelted in a Blast Furnace to obtain Steel.

Steel can be used to craft:

tools

armor

shields

Industrial Steel is used exclusively to craft Industrial Steel Blocks.

This mod is designed for NeoForge.
